key_insight: Sample-based Krylov Quantum Diagonalization (SKQD) provides a scalable method for accurately estimating the ground state of the Heisenberg model on frustrated lattices.
engineering_relevance: This research establishes a new benchmark for the simulation of quantum spin systems, contributing to the development of quantum algorithms in complex systems.
method: Utilized a ZZ deformation of Δ=2 for a sparse Hamiltonian.
Implemented a canonical bitstring compression scheme to enhance configuration recovery.
Employed multiple Krylov subspaces to optimize ground state coverage.
evidence_signal: SKQD achieved sub-percent ground-state energy errors at sizes up to 24 spins, surpassing previous VQE results.
watch_item: Accuracy degrades significantly (19%-36%) beyond 24 spins, indicating limits may be due to shot budgets and circuit depth.
paper_title: Ground-state estimation of the Heisenberg model on frustrated lattices with Sample-based Krylov Quantum Diagonalization
